markdown.spec_line: The specification is the Markdown files in `spec/`, one folder per feature. Start with `spec/README.md`.

export.spec_line: The specification is the compiled export in `spec/`. Start with `spec/MAP.md`; account for every id of your feature in `spec/CHECKLIST.md`.

note: Both formats carry the same 9 spec files: the Markdown the frozen pilot graph was compiled from, and that graph's export (gate passed, 2026-09-30). ownership.yaml and _templates/ are not specs and were not compiled, so neither format has them.
